description: Lane-wise magnitude of the two signed 16-bit values in a. -32768 saturates to 32767. result=|a_k| per lane. aux[1:0]=lanes that saturated. fault=any saturation.
hardware_advantage: Rectifier for envelope/level metering: the most-negative input is the two's-complement trap, and here it is flagged in the same beat.
provenance: original source authored in this workspace; no third-party RTL imported
